# Contributing to the integrated hands-on track

Use the root [contribution guide](../../CONTRIBUTING.md) and the
[hands-on authoring instructions](../../.github/instructions/hands-on.instructions.md).
This community adaptation is maintained in Awesome Copilot Adventures.
Do not imply Microsoft course certification or support.

Keep the numbered exercise/task structure, actual fixtures, official sources,
negative cases, and safe reset. New stacks must identify what was executed versus
provided only as an adaptation exercise.
